{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Re-load the data to ensure clean state
df = pd.read_csv('data/sales.csv')

# Clean revenue: remove commas and convert to float
df['revenue_clean'] = df['revenue'].str.replace(',', '').astype(float)

# Confirm QA orders are absent
qa_rows = df[df['revenue_clean'] == 999999.99]
print(f'QA orders found: {len(qa_rows)}')

# Check if any rows are both converted and refunded
converted_and_refunded = df[(df['converted'] == 1) & (df['status'] == 'refunded')]
print(f'Converted and refunded orders: {len(converted_and_refunded)}')

# Check for -1 in customer_age
print(f'customer_age == -1: {df[df["customer_age"] == -1].shape[0]} rows')"}
